findings.title: Terminal lifecycle event emitted after worker status persistence failed
findings.resolution: Emit terminal worker success/failure only after durable status committed, including exception path; fault-injection regression cases.

findings.title: Failed terminal persistence could trigger replanning and cancellation overwrite
findings.resolution: Guard replanning on committed terminal transition and lock-protected attempt-specific CAS rejects late success after cancellation.

findings.title: Stale attempt cleanup could release or clear successor lease IDs
findings.resolution: Cleanup captures executing attempt's leases; guarded ledger reconciliation prevents stale attempt overwriting successor ownership; regression tests.

findings.title: Same-agent registry renewal reused lease ID across worker attempts
findings.resolution: Scheduler freshLease acquisition requests a distinct record identity, preserving standard renewal for ordinary callers; real registry supersession tests pass.

findings.title: Hyphenated full UUID lease IDs broke CLI ownership release parser
findings.resolution: Retain existing short own_XXXXXXXX format with lock-protected collision avoidance against all retained ownership records; CLI tests pass.
